content: TP routing without using transport protocol modules (low- level routing) The behavior can be optimized if source and target use the same transport protocol (e.g. CanTp-to-CanTp routing). In this case the inbound NPDU can be directly forwarded to the PduR and then sent on the outbound bus without any (resource consuming) TP module involvement.
